INSERT INTO core.user_privacy(user_id, opted_out, deleted_at, reason, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, TRUE, $2, $3, $2)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
              opted_out = TRUE,
              deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at,
              reason = excluded.reason,
              updated_at = excluded.updated_at
